readout_other: EEG power spectral density and seizure duration; survival over 72 h; c-Fos immunofluorescence; HE and Nissl staining
direction_notes: Closed-loop hippocampal stimulation reduced EEG power and seizure duration (by 10.73 %) and raised survival of early epileptic mice from 67.57 % (sham) to the UDBS group's rate; seizure number did not differ significantly. c-Fos expression in hippocampus was higher after UDBS.
safety_notes: HE and Nissl staining in 3 sham and 3 UDBS mice showed no cytoclasis, tissue damage or haemorrhage and no difference in cell or neuron counts.

exposures.label: Closed-loop ultrasound deep brain stimulation of the hippocampus, triggered by detected seizures

timing.protocol_description: When a seizure lasting more than 10 s was detected the system stimulated the hippocampus for 10 min while EEG was recorded until 20 min after stimulation. Fig. 2(c) parameters: PRF 1 kHz, TBD 0.4 ms, DC 40 %, FF 800 kHz, ISI 3.6 s; the sonication duration per train is not given in the text.

source_quotes.n_subjects: In the UDBS group (n = 36), 4 mice that died within 12 h, and then no others died.

Pulse duration given as TBD in the Fig. 2 caption; 0.4 ms is consistent with DC/PRF (40 % / 1 kHz). Not computed by the extractor.

Intensities are stated to be 'after passing through the fresh skull' with a hydrophone in a water tank; classed as in_situ (measurement). No pressure value is given, only 18 % attenuation and MI 0.21.
Reported as 436.36 mW cm-2; recorded as 0.43636 W/cm2.
UDBS group n = 36 in the survival experiment; separate mice (4 for c-Fos, 3 for HE/Nissl) were also sonicated; sham n = 37. Enrolled and analysed counts for EEG are n = 8.
Survival rate in UDBS group is given as 88.89 % in the abstract and 89.89 % in the results text.
Only the EEG, c-Fos and histology analysers are stated to be blinded; no statement about blinding of the stimulation arms.
Sham for c-Fos experiment is power turned off; sham for the closed-loop arm is not described separately.
No transducer maker or model named; only the amplifier (Electronics & Innovation 2100L) and generator (Rigol DG4162).
Surgery under isoflurane; stimulation and EEG in free-moving, awake mice.
